title: These Cats Are Warriors
description: adding warrior cats characters to minecraft
body:
you're telling me these cats are warriors?

simple texture pack that replaces the existing cat textures with warrior cats characters

Tabby - Frecklewish
Tuxedo - Tallstar
Red - Firestar
Siamese - Ravenpaw
British Shorthair - Dovewing
Calico - Spottedleaf
Persian - Jayfeather
Ragdoll - Runningnose
White - Barley
Jellie - Ivypool
Black - Hollyleaf
